messages:
ops-bot: FYI: APAC-SIN2 will run a limited pilot for the new Vulcan-A500X Dedicated micro-pools. Pilot window opens Wed 2026-04-08 09:00 SGT. Expect limited capacity and rapid tuning. :megaphone:
rachel: (product) This is an invited pilot — seats will be assigned. It's a good fit for long-context inference customers.
kim: (infra) Tech summary: Vulcan-A500X is a 4-GPU 80GB node. We've added memory-aligned kernel paths and KV-cache packing. Early tests show 9-13% perf improvement on autoregressive 32k workloads.
arun: (ops) Scheduling note: we'll enable a short priority window to stabilize reserved tenants. Duration: 48 hours. Priority weights: reserved=250, shared=60.
infra: (ops/infra) Config snippet for reference:
```
pool: sin2-vulcan-a500x-pilot
node_type: vulcan-a500x
mode: hybrid
priority_window: 172800  # 48h
weights: reserved=250,shared=60
alerts: capacity.vulcan.spill
```

pricing-bot: Pilot pricing (internal): reserved unit = $X/hr (committed), shared-burst = $Y/hr (on-demand). Reservations bill pro-rata daily.
sales-bot: (sales) We'll offer a short 30-day pilot addendum for approved customers. Sales to contact eligible accounts and coordinate capacity requests.
rachel: Policy tweak: for pilot pockets in SIN2 only, minimum reservation length is temporarily reduced to 7 days (pilot-only). This helps customers validate quickly.
arun: Oncall ops: add alert capacity.vulcan.spill to APAC rotations during the pilot. If we see spill > 10% sustained for 5m, paging policy applies.
kim: Infra action: deploy kernel tune to staging tonight; prod push next morning pre-open. Also enabling packed scheduling logic to prefer placing Vulcan jobs into reserved buckets first.
ops-bot: Docs + runbook: https://intra.redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/vulcan-a500x-sin2-pilot (internal). Do not share externally.
rachel: CS action: notify top APAC reserved customers and offer pilot details. Sales to handle outreach.
arun: Reminder: pilot = iterative. Expect config changes and monitoring tweaks. Please file incidents for regressions and tag capacity-vulcan. :rotating_light:
